new.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?

Operation Vijay — Hyderabad, 1948 — Maj. Gen. El Edroos
Operation Vijay — Junagadh, 1947 — Maj. Gen. J.N. Chaudhuri
new.x: Operation Polo (Hyderabad, 13-17 Sept 1948) was led by Maj. Gen. J.N. Chaudhuri, who then became Military Governor. Operation Vijay (Goa, Dec 1961) was led by K.P. Candeth; El Edroos was the Nizam's army chief; Junagadh was settled by a plebiscite, not a military operation.
new.tq: Polo = Hyderabad 1948 (Chaudhuri); Vijay = Goa 1961 (Candeth).
